verified.name: HACL* (with the EverCrypt provider)
verified.what: Each algorithm (Curve25519, Ed25519, ChaCha20-Poly1305, SHA-2, SHA-3, HMAC, HKDF and others) is proved memory-safe, correct against an F* spec, and secret-independent; C is emitted by KaRaMeL

verified.name: EverCrypt (agile, multiplexing provider over HACL* + Vale)
verified.what: The agile API (choosing among algorithms) and the multiplexing (choosing between the HACL* C and Vale assembly implementations by CPU) are proved; it composes C and assembly verified against shared specs (hashes, Curve25519, AES-GCM)
